question: By how much did accident-year 2022 reported loss (paid plus case) develop between the 31 December 2022 and 31 December 2025 valuations?
final_text:
Accident-year 2022 reported loss (paid plus case reserves, excluding IBNR and ALAE) rose from £12,882,431.30 at 31 December 2022 to £15,074,982.14 at 31 December 2025. That is an increase of £2,192,550.84 over the three years.

ANSWER: 2192550.84
